collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-38  -  THE APPRENTICE WHO NOTICED SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: During a busy repair, a young apprentice notices that an experienced craftsperson has become unusually tired and unsteady.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During a busy repair, a young apprentice notices that an experienced craftsperson has become unusually tired and unsteady.

choices.label: Quietly Ask Whether the Craftsperson Needs a Rest.
Offer to Take Over a Suitable Part of the Task.
Bring Water and Suggest Moving into the Shade.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The craftsperson accepts and resumes lighter work after recovering.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The craftsperson insists on finishing, but agrees to pause when the apprentice expresses concern.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The task exceeds the apprentice's training, so they seek another experienced worker.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The craftsperson feels somewhat better after resting and drinking.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The unsteadiness persists, and the apprentice calls for a healer.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The leader adjusts the assignments without embarrassing the craftsperson.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The leader asks a healer to assess whether continuing work would be appropriate.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The apprentice completes the simpler work while the craftsperson rests.

b1__text.name: Outcome B1
b1__text.text: The apprentice completes the simpler work while the craftsperson rests.
